title: Polish Dijon Chicken Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup made with tender chicken, Polish sausage, and a hint of Dijon mustard.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: use as needed to achieve desired consistency

instructions: In a large pot, sauté the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in a little bit of water until tender.
Add the Polish sausage to the pot and cook until browned.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Dijon mustard to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the bisque and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat and let simmer for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
